mission: Audit-only (FROZEN) — price manipulation vectors, snapshot bypass attempts, multi-currency edges

attack_vectors_attempted.vector: V1 — Frontend price forgery via items[].price = 0.01
evidence: PricingService.php:127-135 — backend re-reads $dbItem->price from DB
tests/Feature/PosPricingSsotProofTest.php (sentinel asserts: forged 0.01 → server overwrites to 20.00 for qty=2 × DB 10.00)
tests/Feature/Sentinels/Zone5PricingSsotConvergenceSentinelTest::test_pr01_*
attack_vectors_attempted.comment: Item.price field in the payload is parsed but never used downstream. Backend authoritative.

evidence: PricingService.php:232-237 — verifiedTotalPrice = unitSum * verifiedQuantity (server-computed)
PricingResult.orderItemInsertRows['total_price'] uses server-computed value, never client payload
Zone5 sentinel test_pr02_pricing_service_overwrites_client_forged_totals (PASS)
attack_vectors_attempted.comment: Per-line total_price is recomputed server-side regardless of payload.

attack_vectors_attempted.vector: V3 — Cross-item ID injection (cheap variation under expensive parent)
evidence: PricingService.php:152-156, 182-187, 207-212 — `enforceCrossItemGuards` checks `dbVar->item_id === item->item_id` for each variation/extra/addon
tests/Feature/Orders/CrossItemGuardTest.php sibling test exists
All 4 PricingRequest factories set enforceCrossItemGuards=true
attack_vectors_attempted.comment: Throws 422 'Variation ID X n\'appartient pas à l\'article Y' on mismatch.

attack_vectors_attempted.vector: V4 — Hidden-surface option leak (e.g. POS-only addon smuggled into kiosk order)
evidence: PricingService.php:461-463 — surface = req->context (pos|kiosk|web)
PricingService.php:479, 501, 537 — isVisibleOn($surface) check on every option
ItemVariation/ItemExtra/ItemAddon::isVisibleOn enforces visibility-list match
attack_vectors_attempted.comment: Per-surface visibility honored. Kiosk cannot order POS-hidden options.

attack_vectors_attempted.vector: V5 — Manual discount injection on kiosk/web
evidence: PricingService.php:339 — manualDiscount only applied if context in ['pos','table']
PricingRequest::forKiosk + ::forWeb hardcode manualDiscount=0.0 at factory level
attack_vectors_attempted.comment: Two-layer defense — even if context is somehow forged at payload level, the factory injection prevents kiosk/web manual discount.

attack_vectors_attempted.vector: V6 — Coupon abuse (try to use customer-specific coupon as different customer)
evidence: DiscountCalculator.php:17 — resolveCouponById(couponId, subtotal, customerUserId) validates ownership
CouponService handles validity window, customer match, min order, max uses
attack_vectors_attempted.comment: Coupon validation is server-side. Cross-customer coupon use blocked.

attack_vectors_attempted.vector: V7 — Composition snapshot tampering (UPDATE column post-insert)
attack_vectors_attempted.outcome: DEFEATED at application layer (P3 V1.1 backlog at DB layer)
evidence: Zone5 sentinel test_pr03 grep-asserts ZERO update/save/assign call sites in app/
5 builder-driven INSERT sites + 1 copy-forward INSERT (refund mirror) — all preserve immutability
PR04 sentinel proves snapshot remains frozen across mid-day item repricing
attack_vectors_attempted.comment: Application layer immutability is rigorously enforced. DB-level BEFORE UPDATE trigger missing (P3 backlog acknowledged). Would require direct DB user with UPDATE grant + bypass of all application code — out of scope for V1 threat model.

attack_vectors_attempted.vector: V8 — env() bypass to disable SSOT in production
evidence: grep -rn 'env(' app/Services/Pricing/ → ZERO matches
PricingSsotFlagProductionStableSentinelTest pins config/pricing.php default + .env.example + .env.testing + 2 CI workflows to PRICING_USE_SSOT=true
Any flip to false in any of those 5 files fails CI loudly
attack_vectors_attempted.comment: Even a malicious deploy that flips the env var would not survive CI.

attack_vectors_attempted.vector: V9 — Stripe cent-rounding edge (€9.99 → 999 cents not 998)
evidence: Zone5 PR07 sentinel: `(int) round((float) 9.99 * 100) === 999`
PHP round() default HALF_UP — €12.345 → 1235 cents (never loses a cent of revenue)
attack_vectors_attempted.comment: Round-before-cast pattern (CTO P0-#6 audit 2026-05-16 regression) pinned.

attack_vectors_attempted.vector: V10 — Mid-cart published profile swap (admin republishes wizard profile while customer composes)
evidence: PricingService.php:557-657 assertComposerStepConstraints projects the CURRENT published profile and validates payload selections against it
tests/Feature/Composer/ProfilePublishMidCartRejectionTest sibling test exists
Throws 422 'Composition : le choix #X n\'appartient pas au profil publié' if selection no longer belongs
attack_vectors_attempted.comment: Mid-cart server revalidation correct. Customer told to refresh.

attack_vectors_attempted.vector: V11 — Menu-formula ratio drift (frontend shows 1.20€ but backend charges 0€ or 3€)
evidence: menuRoleAdjustedAddonPrice in PricingService.php:793-813 + CompositionSnapshotBuilder.php:171-191
Both read same config('kiosk.menu_pricing')
Frontend kioskPricing.js reads same config via window.foodkingConfig.kioskMenuPricing (master.blade.php)
test-e2e/borne E-001 fix 2026-05-10 regression sentinel
attack_vectors_attempted.comment: Three-way single source: frontend, PricingService, CompositionSnapshotBuilder all read same config. Cannot drift while config is canonical.

attack_vectors_attempted.outcome: OUT-OF-SCOPE for V1 Le Cayenne (EUR single-currency)
evidence: PricingService treats all amounts as plain floats with no currency tag
Stripe gateway hardcoded to EUR via app config
No multi-tenant currency support detected
attack_vectors_attempted.comment: V1.1 backlog if SaaS multi-tenancy with different currencies is opened. Not a P0 today.

attack_vectors_attempted.vector: V13 — Branch-scoped pricing leak (one branch's prices used for another)
evidence: PricingService.php:47-55 — branchId passed to AvailabilityService::assertItemsOrderableForBranch
BranchScope global scope (CLAUDE.md §9) auto-applies on 11 models including Item, OrderItem
ChoiceAvailabilityResolver.assertSelectionsOrderable($req->branchId, ...) at L546
attack_vectors_attempted.comment: Branch isolation enforced top-down. Items.price is global per item (no branch_id_scope on price column today — but item visibility per branch IS enforced).

evidence: DiscountCalculator.php:22-29 manualDiscount returns 0 if requested > subtotal
PricingService.php:355 — `max(0.0, rawTotal)` floor prevents negative totals
attack_vectors_attempted.comment: Cannot achieve negative price even with hostile discount.

attack_vectors_attempted.vector: V15 — TTC/HT double-counting (apply tax on top in TTC mode)
evidence: PricingService.php:350-354 — explicit branch: TTC mode skips `+totalTax`
TaxCalculator::lineTaxAmountFromTTC extracts tax FROM the TTC total (does not add it)
tests/Feature/Pricing/TaxInclusivePricesTest.php sibling test
attack_vectors_attempted.comment: Single TTC/HT switch at totalization step. No risk of double-applying tax.

verdict: GREEN — all 15 attack vectors defeated. Z-5 Pricing SSOT is the most rigorously sentinel-pinned subsystem in V1. No surprise P0/P1 surface in frozen PricingService.php. Recommendation: confirm Wave 1 verdict and move on. V1.1 backlog: DB-level BEFORE UPDATE trigger on composition_snapshot (Z5-DBA-P3-01), KioskMenuRatio extract (Z5-ARCH-P3-01).
